IS 7391 : Part 2 : 2026 Cotton Covered Copper Conductors - Specification - Part 2 Rectangular Conductors
ICS 29.060.10
ICS 29.060.10
ETD 33
ETD 33
1 SCOPE
1.1 This standard (Part 2) covers the requirements and dimensions for rectangular copper conductors covered with cotton yarn.
1.2 It does not apply to rectangular conductors covered with cotton braiding.
1.3 The requirements of the standard are applicable to conductors having thickness from 0.80 up to and including 5.6 mm and width from 2 up to and including 16 mm. A schedule of preferred sizes is given in IS 13730 (Part 0/Sec 2).
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
